name: Meridian 8 XL
notes: The Landscape NOON, after its manual: eight channels with MOD, mute and CV mute buttons, velocity as the gate’s voltage, odd / even CV (drones), nine LINK buttons, CYMPATH’s voltage starving, the touch plates (touch, press, aftertouch, left plate), the audio input fed by the channels’ `to in` or a cable (the 1-2 link opens it), individual outputs, the passive mix’s bleed (1: mono). Not here: audio from outside the browser.
